title: 暮らしの場面（トイレ・風呂・掃除）
subject_en: Everyday household chore scenes, each ONE adult person in casual clothes with a small prop, loose hand-drawn style with dot eyes, plain background Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
lead: トイレ・風呂・洗面所の掃除や、洗濯・ごみ出しなど、家事の場面12点です。家事の分担表や暮らしの記事に使えます。
items: a person in rubber gloves scrubbing a toilet bowl with a brush
a person scrubbing a bathtub with a sponge, sleeves rolled up
a person wiping a washbasin and mirror with a cloth
a person wiping a large window with a squeegee
a person on a step stool cleaning a kitchen range hood
a person kneeling and cleaning a sink drain with a brush
a person pushing a flat mop across the floor
a person hanging shirts and towels on a drying rack by a window
a person carrying two trash bags out of the front door
a person putting books and toys into storage boxes
a person sitting on a sofa with a cup of tea after cleaning
